dedupe_keys.name: energydata info world bank open data portal for energy

description: energydata.info (World Bank open data portal for energy) is an open data portal listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries, published or maintained by World Bank Energy Sector Management Assistance Program and partners. The portal hosts about 1,190 datasets on power systems, electrification, renewable resource assessments, transmission and distribution networks, energy demand, policies and plans and related boundaries and demographics, mostly for developing countries, with a strong Sub-Saharan African share. Datasets come from the World Bank, WorldPop, KTH, GIZ, NRECA, Facebook, the IEA and partner organisations. Coverage: about 100 countries, most in Sub-Saharan Africa. Each dataset page lists its files (mostly ZIP, CSV, PDF, GeoJSON and shapefile) and the portal offers a CKAN API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset; about 1,060 of 1,191 datasets state CC-BY-4.0 and 66 CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system, electrification and renewable-resource planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
